description.value:
You strip the noise out of the lie.

When a creature within 12 squares of you is about to suffer a deceit-based penalty on a roll—such as imposed disadvantage from illusions, deliberate misinformation, fear propaganda, or a manipulative magical effect—you can use your reaction to cut through it.

  • The disadvantage, reroll, or penalty from that deceitful source is canceled for that one roll.
  • You can use this feature a number of times equal to your tier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a a Soma Break.

This does not end the underlying effect; it simply refuses to let this particular moment be distorted.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Clear the Signal
Recovery: tier uses / Soma Break  ·  Action: Reaction  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
Cancel a deceit-based penalty (illusion-imposed disadvantage, fear propaganda, manipulative magic) on one roll within 12 squares Doesn't end the underlying effect — just refuses to let this moment be distorted. Recovers on Soma Break.
